question: Ticket ea19fc079c0b says "Bus request uses to='inference_domain' (decision 2)", but outline 13.3.2 reads "Device name on the command line and bus: inference" (Outline 13.3.2 specifies 'Device name on the command line and bus: inference', not 'inference_domain'. The same device cannot have two different bus names; one must be corrected.). Which stands, the ticket or the outline?
why_it_blocks: the ticket and the component outline disagree; building it would build one of them wrong
answer: The outline stands as the design: the device becomes cairn/devices/inferenceproxy/ answering to 'inference' (13.3, 13.3.2). Measured 2026-11-05: that rename is unbuilt — the live device is cairn/devices/inference_domain/ and answers only to 'inference_domain' on the bus (bus_client.inference_bus = reach('inference_domain')), and no ticket carries the rename; it is captured as idea 2026-11-05-outline-13-3-says-the-inference-proxy. Ticket ea19fc079c0b chooses no name: its tooth asks the live address, exactly as bus_client.models_stack does, and the rename will repoint both through one address.
